 The Warriors will be short-handed for the front end of their home back-to-back against the LA Clippers on Sunday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Guard Steph Curry and forward Draymond Green both have been ruled out for Sunday's game at Chase Center as the Warriors manage injuries.
 Curry will sit while managing his right knee injury, and Green will miss the game to rest a bilateral low back injury.
 It will be the second game missed this season for both Curry and Green, as they sat out the Warriors' loss to the Phoenix Suns on Oct. 24.
 Curry missed two months at the end of last season with a right knee injury, and the Warriors are taking a cautious approach early this season by keeping the 38-year-old from playing in both games of a back-to-back.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Curry is averaging 29.2 points on 47.7 percent shooting from the field and 44.0 percent shooting from 3-point range in five games this season.
 Green is averaging 3.0 points, 7.2 assists and 5.2 rebounds in five games this season.
 After facing the Clippers, the Warriors host the Suns on Monday night, with Curry and Green likely available.
